quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangsu Novoray New Material results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Li Xiaodong (H1 2026 results briefing): phase 1 of the ultra-pure spherical powder for high-performance high-speed substrates project is running at a high capacity utilization rate, and planning and design work for the high-thermal-conductivity high-purity spherical powder project is proceeding in order. On demand, he said H1 electronic-circuit substrate demand grew overall, with demand for high-performance high-speed substrates and IC substrates rising rapidly and pushing upstream fillers toward higher-end grades; semiconductor packaging-material demand is also rising, lifting demand for spherical silica and spherical alumina with lower cut points, denser packing, lower radioactivity and high thermal conductivity; he expects this structural shift to raise the share of the company's high-end products further.
